description: 災害時の指定緊急避難場所・指定避難所 [evacuation shelters and public facilities and disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 桑名市. 災害時の指定緊急避難場所・指定避難所について 災害時に備えて、家族の皆さんや職場の人と一緒に、自宅や勤務先近くの指定緊急避難場所や指定避難所を確認しておきましょう。 留意事項 - お住まいの地域ごとに指定緊急避難場所・指定避難所を限定していません。 自宅や滞在場所から近い、行きやすいなど実情に合わせて移動してください。 - すべ... Coverage: 桑名市. The portal files it under the publisher 桑名市. Its tags are 避難所, 防災. It offers 6 resource(s) in csv, pdf. The portal shows 2024-03-19 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
